model_annotation: The image displays two line plots, labeled A and B, both depicting trends over time from 2008 to 2021, with the x-axis labeled "Години" (Years) and marked at intervals of approximately 5 years (2008, 2012/2013, 2017, 2021). Plot A shows the "Средни летопари (дни)" (Average growing season in days) on the y-axis, which is scaled linearly from 200 to 280 days. The red line with black circular markers starts at 280 days in 2008, dips to 265 days in 2012/2013, rises slightly to 270 days, then declines sharply to 240 days in 2017, and further drops to 200 days in 2021. Plot B displays the "Структурен ефект върху средни летопари (%)" (Structural effect on average growing season, in percent) on the y-axis, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 2.0%. The red line with black circular markers begins at 1.5% in 2008, decreases to 0.9% in 2012/2013, dips further to 0.8% in 2013, rises to 1.2% in 2017, and then increases steeply to 2.0% in 2021. Both plots use the same x-axis scale and tick marks, and each line is represented with a solid red line connecting black circular data points.
